channel.title: Money for Nothing
channel.desc: Upcycling expert Sarah Moore is at Beaconsfield Recycling Centre in Buckinghamshire, scouring the site for items that can be given a new lease of life rather than hitting the skips. Screen printer Zoe tries to turn soggy gazebo covers into plush cushions, while Larissa rolls up her sleeves to take a well-loved sofa from comfy to cool. For her own project, Sarah splits a sideboard in two to try to double its potential.
